text:
kai: Quick design review note: the Console help tile says 'Endpoints' but the linked docs H1 and code samples use 'Route'. Users landed in docs and get a vocabulary mismatch.

meera: Good catch. Which term do we want to pick for the product-facing surfaces?

oliver: Historically engineering used 'route' (it's the manifest key). Support & marketing say customers look for 'endpoint' more often.

stylebot: style-guide bot: Recommend "Endpoints" for user-facing UI, "route" in API examples. Add a glossary alias.

kai: Accessibility point: SR reads the widget label; if console says 'Endpoints' but doc says 'Route' it sounds inconsistent. We should update aria-labels and make the alias explicit.

meera: UX proposal: keep the Console label as 'Endpoints' (short and discoverable). In the Help inlay, add a tiny 'Terminology' link (icon + label) that opens an anchored glossary entry at the top of the docs: "Endpoints (aka routes)". Avoid long parentheticals in the header.

oliver: Docs action: I'll add /docs/endpoints as a canonical anchor and a short redirect from /docs/routes -> /docs/endpoints for 90 days. Also annotate YAML samples with a 1-line note: "In manifests the field is called 'route'."

ux-ci: I'll prepare a Figma mock for the inlay micro-link and run a screen-reader pass. Will post before EOD.

meera: Engineering: can you also add a search synonym (route -> endpoints) so users find the canonical page?

oliver: Yes, will add search synonym and a small analytics ping when the glossary link is clicked so we can measure confusion.

kai: Owners & timeline: design=ux-ci by EOD, docs=oliver by Wed, eng=meera will queue redirects and search synonym next sprint.

meera: One more: ensure the inlay link opens in a new tab on mobile and ARIA says "Terminology: Endpoints equals routes" so SR users get context.

kai: TL;DR: Console stays 'Endpoints'; docs add alias and redirect; add micro-link in help panel; fix aria and search synonyms. Owners noted. :white_check_mark:
